title: My programming revelation: my first experience typing code
summary: Recalling my first programming job, let’s first talk about how to learn programming.
markdown:
Recalling my first programming job, let’s first talk about how to learn programming.
## College level
I was majoring in Internet at the time, and I took part in the teacher's programming training class when I was a sophomore. If I didn't meet the teacher's requirements, I would be eliminated. At that time I could only write one line of code.
```plain text
System.out.println("Hello World");
```
At the beginning of the training, you have to complete the programming questions assigned by the teacher to ensure that you are not eliminated. You rely on Baidu, but you don’t know a line of code.
In the middle of the training, it was necessary to publicly talk about what each line of code did. Simply pasting the code was no longer enough. I started to search for the function of each line of code. It was actually a translation from English to Chinese. Fortunately, I passed it.
Later in the training, the programming questions became more difficult. According to the rules of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, handwriting calculators, it was this question that made me get started and understand the essence of programming: only if you think about it, programming can do it.
## Internship
Later, I was recommended by a teacher to work in a company at the State Grid. During that time, I started studying when I got home from work and started to understand various technologies, such as mongodb, virtual machines, and hadoop. Although I didn’t understand them, I practiced them all according to the online tutorials. I remember that in order to build a hadoop environment, I started several virtual machines on my laptop and followed the step-by-step instructions. I was so happy when I saw the results.
Later, the teacher recommended me to learn js, and later I learned about jQuery. From then on, I started to get in touch with front-end related things.
## First programming job
I was working as a front-end employee at that time. I remember that the technology stack at that time still used template language and the development efficiency was low. When developing new projects later, I advocated the separation of front-end and back-end. I remember that I also used jQuery to quickly generate lists and forms. As long as the back-end provided interfaces and fields, I configured the file code JSON and could complete a module in a few minutes. The back-end guys were shocked at that time.
Since then, my front-end career began~
##End
There is no shortcut to learning technology, you still need to work steadily and take time. I remember what my teacher said about me. Among the people I trained, I was not the smartest, but I was the hardest working. I basically relied on time to survive this journey. By enduring the time, I also gained several abilities:
- Search ability, master search skills, can greatly shorten the time to find answers
- Learning ability, able to quickly master technologies that have never been learned before
- Flexibility and ability to quickly learn different programming languages
